about: Public, source-backed resume facts for Kevin Rajan. Presentation layers (the hermes-jobapp canvas, the kvnloo/cv PDFs) read from this file. No phone number or email: those live only in the private resume sources.
name: Kevin Rajan
headline: Software engineer building agent products: Hermes runtime reliability, native agent UX, and the evidence systems around them.

roles.title: Founder & CEO
roles.summary: Solo founder. Builds agent infrastructure and products on top of Hermes Agent and other harnesses.
bullets: Landed 41 commits on NousResearch/hermes-agent main (Aug to Oct 2026) across runtime correctness, context compaction safety, kanban, desktop, and platform adapters.
Built Hermes Tern, a native terminal UI for Hermes (agent orb, plan review, BTW threads, forked sessions in sibling panes, OpenUI previews, voice).
Built Dash, an Expo phone app and Bun bridge over Tailscale that keeps one live thread per harness (Hermes, OMP, Codex, Claude Code, Grok); in daily use.
Designed z0, a registry and installer for a personal agent stack (z0intelligence, AODL, Tokenomics, z0evals), with z0archy as its zoomable architecture explorer.
Runs a verified open-source loop: leased claims, isolated worktrees, evidence receipts, independent verification, human merge.

bullets: Designed and applied detailed rubrics for LLM evaluation; wrote logic, math, and physics prompts to elicit reasoning failures for process-supervision feedback.
Large-scale preference labeling and comparative ranking (RLHF, DPO, RLAIF); multimodal and tool-use evaluations.

bullets: Reached the top 1 to 5% in Kovaak's, Valorant, and Apex by benchmarking and removing training bottlenecks.

Built pipelines that publish biweekly golden Windows and RHEL AMIs.
Ran DevOps onboarding for 500+ new hires.
Product owner for a preventative-health platform concept.
